# ChatMemberUpdatedHandler

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.handlers.ChatMemberUpdatedHandler`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(callback: Callable, filters = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The ChatMemberUpdated handler class. Used to handle changes in the status of a chat member.
It is intended to be used with [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md).

For a nicer way to register this handler, have a look at the
[`on_chat_member_updated`](../decorators/on_chat_member_updated.md) decorator.

### Parameters

- **`callback`** (`Callable`)
  Pass a function that will be called when a new ChatMemberUpdated event arrives. It takes
  *(client, chat_member_updated)* as positional arguments (look at the section below for a detailed
  description).

- **`filters`** (`Filters`)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of updates to be passed in your callback function.

Other parameters:
    client (`Client`):
        The Client itself, useful when you want to call other API methods inside the handler.

    chat_member_updated ([`ChatMemberUpdated`](../types/user_and_chats/ChatMemberUpdated.md)):
        The received chat member update.
